abstract: Urothelial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation is a rare morphologic variant of bladder cancer, and only a limited number of cases have been reported. We present two cases of bladder cancer with choriocarcinomatous features that had different outcomes. The clinical and pathologic features are reviewed to better understand the natural history of this malignant neoplasm. The histologic features of the tumor were compared between the two cases. Immunoperoxidase staining was performed on the tumor cells with polyclonal beta human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) antibody. A comprehensive literature search revealed an additional 25 confirmed cases, which are summarized in this presentation. Of the 27 patients, only 3 patients were reported to be alive without evidence of disease after treatment. The majority presented with invasive tumors and had a mean survival of 12 months after diagnosis. Chemotherapy, radiation, or radical surgery in advanced stages did not improve survival. Choriocarcinoma in visceral organs usually occurs with high-grade carcinomas and we believe that it is best considered dedifferentiation of the tumor. Urothelial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation is an extremely aggressive tumor, and in the rare patient with early stage disease and normal to moderately elevated serum β-hCG levels, long-term survival can be achieved with radical surgery.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌様分化を伴う尿路上皮癌は膀胱癌の稀な形態学的亜型であり、報告例は限られている。我々は、転帰の異なる膀胱癌の2症例を報告する。両症例の臨床病理学的特徴を検討し、本悪性腫瘍の自然史の理解を深めることを目的とした。両症例の腫瘍の組織学的特徴を比較した。多クローナル抗β-hCG抗体を用いて腫瘍細胞に免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色を行った。包括的な文献検索により、さらに25例の確定例が見つかり、本報告にまとめた。27例中、治療後に無病生存していたのは3例のみであった。多くは浸潤性腫瘍として提示され、診断後の平均生存期間は12か月であった。化学療法、放射線療法、または進行期での根治的手術は生存率を改善しなかった。内臓器の絨毛癌は通常高異型度癌に伴って出現し、我々はこれを腫瘍の脱分化と考えるのが最善であると考える。絨毛癌様分化を伴う尿路上皮癌は極めて侵襲性の高い腫瘍であるが、早期で血清β-hCG値が正常から中等度上昇にとどまる稀な症例では、根治的手術により長期生存が得られる可能性がある。
